description:
I entered a long position (2 lots) last night around 5 pm PST, but the market reversed overnight so /ES stayed red until hour before the open. Therefore, I decided to close my position for breakeven shortly after open during the pump. I closed the long position around 6:32am PST for +2 pts. Then it broke out, scalped some calls on the way, but I did not feel comfortable with my entries and felt like I missed the move after closing my overnight longs. Did not enter anything to hold throughout the day; just entered a short position towards EOD during the reversal. Moved my stop down to secure profit at the top of 2nd to last 5-min candle before close.

14pts; 7 round turns

Today was a trend day. However, 7780Cs did not break out until later in the day. I did not hold as the relative 3-day volume was around 85%, on a low volume trend day reversal can easily happen, but these contracts ended up breaking out to around $15k (10/contracts) towards eod. Still expired worthless though.

18 fills; all less than 1-min scalps
